verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a custodial account where a business can hold a stablecoin balance on MoonPay. It also states no availability, geographies, or gating for such an account. What is shown is adjacent: enterprise fiat-to-stablecoin conversion, stablecoin issuance infrastructure, and wallet creation for end users during purchase, none of which is a documented business balance-holding account.

support.subject: As a finance lead, my business can hold a stablecoin balance on the platform — documented custodial accounts with stated availability, geographies, and any gating quoted honestly
